page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a member of the Big data d1 instance family, engineered to provide high-density local disk storage paired with balanced compute and memory resources. Built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture, this server provision provides 24 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Backing the processing unit is 96.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A primary architectural characteristic of this server is its storage capacity, offering 70,866 GB of bundled local HDD storage. Network throughput is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system operates without dedicated hardware accelerators, featuring zero GPUs, and relies strictly on magnetic storage rather than NVMe or SSD tiers.

From an infrastructure and cost perspective, the integration of extensive HDD arrays yields high cost efficiency for bulk data density, trading lower random I/O performance and latency for raw storage volume. This profile is suited for distributed processing frameworks, sequential data ingest pipelines, log storage, data warehousing, and big data ecosystems such as Hadoop or MapReduce.
